title: Independent oracle tests via OpenSSL and Python — worth defending
description: All test vectors in both crates come from external oracles (OpenSSL CLI, Python base64/quopri modules, RFC examples). No test derives expected values from the code under test. The round-trip smime_tests also use OpenSSL as an independent validator for sign() and encrypt(). This is cryptography — if the tests used the same code as both producer and oracle they would prove nothing. A future contributor who suggests simplifying tests to 'just compare to what the function returns' should be shown this is the wrong approach for crypto.
close_reason: Oracle test methodology documented in CLAUDE.md; all smime test fixtures from OpenSSL/Python oracles, cross-validated
